videos.title: Starter Kit Day 2: the 5-part prompt, before and after

scenes.spoken: Same AI, same question, two very different answers. The difference is the prompt.
scenes.on_screen_text: Why your AI answers feel generic

scenes.spoken: Here's the one-liner. It works, but you get a generic, slightly stiff note.
scenes.card_text: Write a message to my neighbor about their dog barking.

scenes.spoken: Now the same request with five parts. Role: who the AI should act as. Context: your situation, the part most people skip. Task: exactly what you want. Format: length and tone. And an example of your usual tone.
scenes.on_screen_text: Role · Context · Task · Format · Examples
scenes.card_text:
Act as a tactful communicator who helps neighbors stay on good terms.

Context: My next-door neighbor's dog barks most weekdays from about 8am
to noon while they're at work. I work from home, so it's hard to take
calls. We get along well and I don't want to sound like I'm complaining.

Task: Write a short, friendly text message that raises the issue and
suggests we figure out a solution together.

Format: Under 80 words. Warm and casual. No passive-aggressive phrasing.

Example of my usual tone: "Hey! Hope your weekend was good. Quick
question for you when you get a sec..."

scenes.spoken: This time you get a message you could send as is.

videos.title: Myth: why AI makes things up

scenes.spoken: AI might recommend a book that doesn't exist: a title that sounds perfect, by a real author, that was never written.
scenes.on_screen_text: Why AI makes things up

scenes.spoken: That isn't a glitch or a lie. AI writes answers by predicting the most plausible next words, not by looking up verified facts. Usually those are the same thing. Sometimes they aren't.

scenes.spoken: And a made-up answer sounds exactly as sure of itself as a correct one. Errors cluster around specifics: names, dates, numbers, quotes, links and citations.

scenes.card_text:
For each book you listed, rate how confident you are that the title,
author and year are exactly right (high, medium or low). Flag anything
I should double-check before I buy it.

GOAL:       Every enquiry is categorized and has a draft reply within 5 minutes

CHECKS:     Before: JSON valid and category allowed
            After: CRM confirms the record was saved

OWNER:      Sales lead, alerted by email on any failure

scenes.spoken: Experimenter: you've tried AI, but it isn't part of your routine yet. Next step: using AI consistently, not just occasionally.

scenes.spoken: Implementer: AI is already part of how you work. Next: turning one-off chats into repeatable workflows.

scenes.spoken: Scaler: you use AI confidently and often. Your opportunity is automations and team-wide systems, with the right guardrails.
